hint_fr: Votre roi est coincé devant son pion. Pour sortir, il aura besoin d'un abri contre les échecs de côté — et c'est votre tour qui le construira, en se plaçant d'où elle pourra s'interposer plus tard. Mais d'abord, repoussez encore le roi noir d'une colonne.
hint_en: Your king is stuck in front of its pawn. To step out it will need shelter from the side checks — and your rook will build it, by standing where it can block later. But first, push Black's king one more file away.

claims.note: Syzygy tablebase (tablebase.lichess.ovh), checked 2026-10-08: both stored moves keep the win, but so do most rook moves at each step (Lucena is won many ways) — hence onlyMove:false. At move 1, Rc1 and Re6 only draw and Re2 loses; at move 2, Rc1 and Rf2/Rf6/Rf7/Rf8 only draw.
